mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, email, google_id, line_id, password, title, bio, avatar, location, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, email, google_id, line_id, password, title, bio, avatar, location, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE google_id = #{googleId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, email, google_id, line_id, password, title, bio, avatar, location, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE line_id = #{lineId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, email, title, bio, avatar, location, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET google_id = #{googleId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET avatar = #{avatar} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, email, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, nickname, phone, email, google_id, line_id, password) VALUES (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{googleId}, #{lineId}, #{password})
